query: ALTER TABLE container_registry_manifest ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_chk_sha_digest CHECK(digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_chk_size_positive CHECK(size > 0), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_chk_sha_index_digest CHECK(index_digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_manifest_fk_index_digest FOREIGN KEY(index_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_manifest_index(digest);
